model: RandomForestClassifier (sklearn, 500 trees, min_samples_leaf=2) with median imputation of zero-coded missing values; stratified 80/20 split, random_state=42
notes: Zeros in glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin and bmi were treated as missing and median-imputed on train. followup_score is highly predictive (r=0.83) and may be recorded after diagnosis; without it test accuracy is 0.756, so it should be verified as a legitimate pre-diagnosis input.
